plan.title: framework-gap: Prefer-A leftover-complete must use scope:complete / stampDeliveryProvenance (no hand productMerge stamps)

narratives.Description: Prefer-A leftover-complete must call swarm:finalize-cohort or scope:complete so stampDeliveryProvenance writes canonical disposition. Informal productMerge or productPr stamps on completed briefs are refused by verify:completed-write-guard going forward.
narratives.Overview: One writer rule: leftover-complete MUST call swarm:finalize-cohort or scope:complete → stampDeliveryProvenance; no hand productMerge/productPr. Fail-closed verify:completed-write-guard on new completed/ adds: consistency + informal-stamp refuse + code-bearing disposition contract. Thin skill pin in swarm Phase 6 / Grok through-merge Prefer-A: leftover = finalize-cohort + delivery evidence. Reuse stampDeliveryProvenance / evaluateDeliveryGate / evaluateCompletedPlanConsistency; name two disposition surfaces. Regression specimens: #5477/#5601 negative fixture; #5551 shape comparison only; CHANGELOG note.
narratives.Labels: swarm, agent-experience, process, source-of-truth, urgent, area:cli, area:vbrief, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap, core-capabilities, promise:lifecycle, promise:gates, promise:swarm
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add fail-closed verify:completed-write-guard so new completed adds require evaluateCompletedPlanConsistency green and classifyStoredDeliveryDisposition not unverified. Route Prefer-A leftover-complete exclusively through swarm:finalize-cohort or scope:complete into stampDeliveryProvenance. Pin swarm Phase 6 Prefer-A leftover text to finalize-cohort plus delivery evidence and cite the #5551 positive shape. Reuse stampDeliveryProvenance, evaluateDeliveryGate, and evaluateCompletedPlanConsistency without inventing a second leftover dialect. Add regression specimens for #5477/#5601 negatives and #5551 shape comparison, plus a CHANGELOG Unreleased note.
narratives.UserStory: As a through-merge operator, I want leftover-complete to use stampDeliveryProvenance, so that completed briefs never land with informal productMerge stamps.
narratives.Traces: Prefer-A Bound leftover-complete write-guard; issue #5602; positive shape #5551; negative specimens #5477/#5601.
